# Tuning System

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/TuningSystem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reference frame for musical pitch values — a named system that defines how pitch degrees, frequency ratios, or cents are interpreted. 12-EDO is one [`TuningSystem`](gmeow-TuningSystem.md) individual among many (Principles 9, 11).

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ReferenceFrame`](gmeow-ReferenceFrame.md)
